description: Cases every implementation of nemar.sensor-layout.v1 reproduces. Each case gives positions (name, x, y, z in the frame coordinate_system names, or, for template positions that name a montage, in that montage's frame, RAS, with coordinate_system n/a; null is not finite) and either the expected layout (center and center_method, montage or sphere, in the ALS frame, theta_deg and radius per row, null for a row without a finite position) or the word it is refused with. Template positions are centered on the montage's own center, its file's center; measured positions carry bounds, their singular_ratio and radius_ratio (null when not reached), which decide positions_flat against 0.05 and 3, within tolerance.bounds_absolute. The expected theta and radius are eegprep's convertlocs(..., 'cart2topo') of the positions minus the center, with -180 written 180. frames lists the BIDS coordinate systems of each orientation: an implementation gives frame_als's layout for every ALS name and frame_ras's for every RAS name. cart2topo gives centered ALS points and the theta and radius each converts to, with no fit (theta within tolerance.cart2topo_theta_deg degrees, with no wrapping, and radius within tolerance.radius). Tolerances for the cases: radius within tolerance.radius; theta through the planar point (cos(theta) * radius, sin(theta) * radius), within tolerance.planar of the expected one, because theta is undefined at the pole; the center within tolerance.center_relative_to_scale times the largest distance of a finite position from their centroid.

cases.name: hydrocel_32_off_center
cases.description: eegprep's HydroCel 32 cap in centimeters (CapTrak), translated by (3, -1.5, 2): the sphere fit recovers the center.

cases.name: frame_ras
cases.description: Twelve HydroCel positions in an RAS frame; every RAS name gives this layout.

cases.name: frame_als
cases.description: The same twelve positions rotated into ALS; every ALS name gives this layout.

cases.name: ring_coplanar
cases.description: Nine positions on one circle, unevenly spaced and tilted 25 degrees: in one plane, so their singular ratio is 0 and they fix no head; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: disk_flat
cases.description: Thirty-two positions scattered over a disk in the plane z = 0: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: noisy_disk
cases.description: Forty-eight positions on a 9 cm disk with 0.09 mm of noise out of its plane, as a flat layout measured with noise: a sphere fitted to them would fit the noise; their singular ratio is 0.002, so refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: collinear_positions
cases.description: Five positions on one line: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: nearly_collinear
cases.description: Five positions on one line but for 2.2e-12 off it at the middle one: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: three_positions
cases.description: Three positions, which always lie in one plane: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: coincident_positions
cases.description: Four positions at one point: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: squashed_sphere_inside
cases.description: Sixty-four positions spread over a whole 9 cm sphere, squashed to 0.055 of its height: singular ratio 0.055, against the bound 0.05, with a sphere radius under 1 times their scale; drawn.

cases.name: squashed_sphere_outside
cases.description: Sixty-four positions spread over a whole 9 cm sphere, squashed to 0.045 of its height: singular ratio 0.045, against the bound 0.05, with a sphere radius under 1 times their scale; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: cap_inside
cases.description: Positions on a 9 cm sphere within 21.0 degrees of its top: a shallow cap whose sphere radius is 2.8 times their scale, against the bound 3, with a singular ratio near 0.1; drawn.

cases.name: cap_outside
cases.description: Positions on a 9 cm sphere within 19.0 degrees of its top: a shallow cap whose sphere radius is 3.1 times their scale, against the bound 3, with a singular ratio near 0.1; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: measured_six
cases.description: Six measured positions, F3 F4 C3 C4 P3 P4 of eegprep's 10-5 template (EEGLAB, meters), and no others: no midline, but they span the head (singular ratio 0.15, sphere radius 1.1 times their scale); drawn about the sphere fitted to them.

cases.name: measured_midline_9
cases.description: Nine measured positions on the midline, Fpz to Oz, of eegprep's 10-5 template: they lie in one plane and fix no left or right, so refused (positions_flat); a renderer places them by name instead.

cases.name: missing_positions
cases.description: HydroCel 32 with row 5's y and all of row 20 not finite (written null): those rows get no layout and the fit uses the others.

cases.name: template_montage
cases.description: Template positions: every electrode of the montage GSN-HydroCel-32 (views/montages, RAS meters), with the coordinate system n/a. They are projected about the montage's own center, stored in its file.

cases.name: template_with_a_frame
cases.description: Template positions from a montage that also name a coordinate system (CapTrak) other than n/a: the frame is ambiguous, so refused.

cases.name: template_full_1005
cases.description: Template positions: every electrode of the montage standard_1005, with the coordinate system n/a. A subset is projected about the montage's own center, never a sphere fitted to the subset, so each electrode lands where template_full_1005 puts it.

cases.name: template_midline_9
cases.description: Template positions: the nine midline electrodes, Fpz to Oz, of the montage standard_1005, with the coordinate system n/a. A subset is projected about the montage's own center, never a sphere fitted to the subset, so each electrode lands where template_full_1005 puts it.

cases.name: template_coronal_9
cases.description: Template positions: the nine coronal electrodes, T7 to T8, of the montage standard_1005, with the coordinate system n/a. A subset is projected about the montage's own center, never a sphere fitted to the subset, so each electrode lands where template_full_1005 puts it.

cases.name: template_montage_wrong_case
cases.description: Template positions naming the montage GSN-HydroCel-32 in another case: montage names are matched exactly against the montage list, never through a file system that may fold case: refused (frame_unknown).

cases.name: template_montage_provenance
cases.description: Template positions naming the montage PROVENANCE, the name of the file beside the montages that records where they come from, which is not a montage: refused (frame_unknown).
